notes.content:
We've added a Ninja Star Shooter due to popular demand. Now you can slash away and defend against the new drone enemy with your Ninja Star Shooter.

notes.title: Update 70: Ninja Dojo
notes.content:
Happy New Decade. We have the first update of 2020 for you.

- Reintegrated our classic Music Escape mode, now known as the Ninja Dojo
- Now you can switch between both the Training and Combat modes in-game
- Cleaned up the leaderboards
- Increased the angle at which the enemies run at you
- Brightened up the colors of the bears so that they are easier to see


Any feedback let us know in our Discord and enjoy!

notes.title: Update 68: Custom Music Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34482069/593c4150845994d625ebdedfb203c7a256d92df2.png[/img]
- Added support of multiple .mp3 folders. By default game scans your Windows / Music folder.
[i]To add more folder just add paths in text file inside the game folder. (MusicFolders.txt)[/i]

- The game now uses Tags from all .mp3 files.

- Songs previews now start from 1/3 of songs. Also, preview loading now works smoother.

- The game now recognizes BPM for a song and shows a custom difficulty, based on this data.

notes.title: Update 67: Combat Update Live
notes.content:
You must defend Earth from Rogue AI. Luckily, you've hacked their systems so you can dismember the Evil Robot Teddies to the beat of your own soundtrack!

Combat mode is where you truly get to test your Ninja skills. What's the highest kill streak you can achieve? Our scoring system will reward the best of the best.

[b]What's New[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely New Combat Mode
[*]Plasma Swords
[*]6 more songs included
[*]Abandoned Theme Park level
[*]Evil Robot Teddies
[*]Revamped Scoring System
[*]Custom Song Support
[/list]

The game also supports your own songs, just copy and paste the song directory into the following file: ~\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Music Escape\Music Escape_Data\StreamingAssets\MusicFolders.txt

Use ";" (without "") between paths to add multiple folders.

Want to enjoy the game but can't afford it? Become a Beta tester and we'll give you a copy of the game in exchange for your continued feedback! (limited spots available)
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/hnsKu5h

notes.title: Update 66: June Update
notes.content: Hi everyone! Hope you've been enjoying our Music Escape Combat Trainer so far. We are busy at work preparing the next big update which will put your combat skills to the challenge! So sharpen up your Adamantium Claws and get some more time in with those Nunchakus, because next month your skills will really be put to the test. 🧟

notes.title: Music Escape Build 58: Nunchaku
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34482069/736534a125ea4ad6224c332327c8483c28d42bc3.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone, this is a [i]huge[/i] update and we're happy it's finally here. It’s time to unlock your inner Ninja and upgrade your Nunchaku skills!

The physics for the Nunchaku was especially challenging to recreate, the hardest part was to have realistic centrifugal force in a 3D environment. If you need an extra boost to spin the Nunchaku faster, you can press the Trigger button. 

Gameplay tip: For the Nunchaku, it’s better to swing your arms versus just flicking your wrist.

[u]Build Notes[/u]
- Added new weapon mode "Light Nunchaku”
- Added 3 new tracks: "Bladerunner", "Electronic Music" and "Here We Go"
- Added hard difficulty for the song "All Abroad"
- Added Weapon Selection Screen and Gameplay Mode
- Every weapon now has its own Online and Local Leaderboards
- Added Power, Precision, Timing parameters in song statistics calculation
- Added an average score for every slice
- Nunchaku centrifugal speed can be boosted by pressing Trigger
- Fixed the bug that causes level effects to stop after playing a few songs consecutively
- Now game pauses when Steam menu activated
